title: Fix the Multiplication Table
description: The program should print the multiplication table of 3, from 3x1 to 3x10. Fix the bug.
buggyCode:
for i in range(1, 10):
    print(f"3 x {i} = {3 * i}")
expectedBehavior: The program should print ten lines, ending with '3 x 10 = 30'.
actualProblem: range(1, 10) only produces values 1 through 9, so the table is missing the final '3 x 10 = 30' line.
correctedCode:
for i in range(1, 11):
    print(f"3 x {i} = {3 * i}")
explanation: To loop through 1 to 10 inclusive, the stop argument of range() must be 11, since range() always excludes its stop value.
